shortlist.claimBoundary: Test whether cross-sender coupling between value-driven CPM selection and distributed congestion control creates persistent oscillation, starvation, or unfair equilibria that are predicted out of sample by a local stability model. The two-week claim is simulator and trace based, not a perception-quality claim.

twoWeekImplementationPath.work: On Linux x86_64, recursively clone Artery at e0ddd8c0414b079f28e8efa932f52f66ae5a3c73, use the pinned development container, build, and run the official example. Record image digest, submodule SHAs, build command, and one deterministic event trace. Stop this candidate if the official example cannot be reproduced within three working days.

Implement the published Quality-over-Quantity threshold and adaptive-rate equations as a small trace-driven Artery module. Freeze generated per-sender utility profiles and log every sender-visible input, selected object count, CPM bytes, period, channel busy ratio, queue occupancy, and transmission event.

Run 5- and 15-sender scenarios across three controller gains, three feedback delays, and synchronized/asynchronous starts. Use 10 exploratory seeds to locate a boundary, then freeze it and use 30 new seeds for confirmation. Include feedback-off, half-step integration, and load-matched controls.

sixWeekImplementationPath: Week 1: reproduce and freeze Artery, dependencies, scenario, logs, and a deterministic reference trace.
Week 2: implement the published equations, direct baselines, event-level instrumentation, and preregistered pass/fail tests.

Week 3: if a GPU environment and the official CoSDH checkpoint are available, generate sender-visible CooperScene utility/payload traces; otherwise retain synthetic frozen traces and drop perception claims.
Week 4: run the full 2/5/10/15-sender matrix over gain, delay, load, synchronization, and at least 30 independent seeds per confirmatory cell near the boundary.
Week 5: fit the local Jacobian on development traces, test spectral-radius predictions on held-out cells, and run fairness, starvation, feedback-off, time-step, and load-matched ablations.
Week 6: perform an independent rerun from the frozen manifest, package raw event logs and analysis, and state negative results if coupling or out-of-sample prediction fails.
directBaselines: Fixed equal CPM period and equal sender rate
ETSI-style quantity selector plus Artery LIMERIC DCC
Quality-over-Quantity threshold with a fixed CPM period
Weighted LIMERIC without adaptive value thresholding
FABRIC-style utility-fair rate allocation if its equations can be reproduced without changing the frozen traffic model

shortlist.claimBoundary: Under an explicitly assigned experimental cause-root manifest, test whether root-disjoint evidence admission reduces correlated-failure false acceptance without erasing cooperative coverage. Do not claim authenticated or deployable provenance unless a real lineage mechanism is added.

twoWeekImplementationPath.work: Select one official OpenCOOD/OPV2V multi-agent configuration, obtain the exact checkpoint and validation slice, record hashes and licenses, and complete one-scene inference with at least three agents. Stop if this gate fails.

Create immutable sidecar cause-root IDs before model outputs are inspected. Build paired independent-root and shared-root corruptions while holding agents, visible objects, bytes, model, and scene fixed.

Run a 20-scene development smoke with ego-only, all-fusion, count quorum, random-drop, ROBOSAC if portable, and oracle root-collapse diagnostics. Add wrong, missing, merged, split, and shuffled root-label sensitivity plus one held-out fault family.

sixWeekImplementationPath: Week 1: pass the hashed checkpoint, validation data, license, and at-least-three-agent one-scene inference gate.
Week 2: freeze the cause-root sidecar generator, paired corruption matrix, baselines, and preregistered acceptance metrics.
Week 3: implement root-disjoint quorum and wrong/missing/merge/split/shuffle lineage sensitivity without changing the detector checkpoint.
Week 4: run at least 50 held-out scene/route units across shared and independent roots, corruption severities, and a held-out fault family.
Week 5: compare accuracy, false acceptance, cooperation coverage, bandwidth, and latency against the direct baselines; treat oracle root collapse only as a diagnostic ceiling.
Week 6: independently rerun from the frozen manifest and, only if feasible, repeat the directional result on a second public multi-agent path.

rejected.reason: The local v4 leave-one-out pilot passed its tests but found no natural contract in four target frameworks and never reached a model/checkpoint/evaluator execution. This is evidence against advancing the stated shared-IR boundary, not a missing polish task.

The v7 closure found that the 90-pass cohort is a generator-defined projection of a 120-row release, the cooperator field is not a complete actual-cooperator contract, default execution does not fail the real mismatch, the verifier fix invalidates the checked preflight artifact, and the purported cross-dataset transfer is a local alias. No materially different evidenced boundary was produced.
The only validated executable successor in this audit is clock-receipt-semantic-migration, explicitly excluded by the user; the predecessor does not supply a separate second-candidate loop.

Existing systems/model audits, dossiers, collision review, or v4 panel findings identify a missing online path, causal reachability, natural event, frozen paired outcome, payload/queue map, checkpoint, or license contract that prevents a six-to-twelve-week comparative loop from starting as currently scoped.

These ledger entries were covered by triage, but the completed evidence did not independently verify the full official code/data/license/checkpoint/command path and a direct paired baseline. They are rejected from this shortlist rather than treated as impossible research ideas.

recommendedNextCandidate.position: best non-clock candidate for the next executable loop
why: It has the clearest public simulator substrate and official build/run contract among the remaining finalists.
The nearest official controller paper states the nonlinear feedback and convergence gap directly, leaving a defensible boundary around coupled stability rather than generic congestion control.
Its first falsification uses CPU simulation and frozen utility traces, so it does not depend on an unresolved model checkpoint.
It has strong early kill tests: official-example reproduction, measurable off-diagonal coupling, feedback-off behavior, time-step sensitivity, and held-out stability prediction.

fallback.condition: Use no fallback candidate if Artery cannot run within three working days. Failure-domain-evidence-quorum becomes eligible only after its separate two-day hashed-checkpoint and at-least-three-agent inference gate passes.

rationale.conclusion: Advance one candidate now and retain one conditional reserve; there is no evidence-supported third shortlist entry.
selectionLogic: The decision prioritizes a runnable public stack, a directly comparable baseline set, independent episode- or scene-level samples, and a falsification that can terminate the idea within two weeks.
Coupled adaptive rate stability satisfies those conditions with CPU-first simulation, although Artery still needs reproduction on a supported Linux environment.

Failure-domain evidence quorum has a concrete experiment but remains behind a strict checkpoint and multi-agent execution gate, and its assigned roots constrain the claim to an experimental intervention.
Runtime semantic checkers were not advanced because the completed negative pilot found zero natural contracts; mutation sensitivity alone does not establish utility on real framework drift.
Atomic epoch and prefix causality were not advanced because neither has a verified natural event and dynamic paired model outcome.
Release-population-preflight was not revived because its precise novelty closure failed and no different evidenced boundary emerged.
evidenceLimits: No large model or simulator stack was executed in this audit except the local semantic-contract test suite.
CooperScene's exact checkpoint hash is carried from the existing asset audit and was not independently recomputed in this pass.
The CoopDet3D checkpoint endpoint and size were verified, but the interrupted download produced no complete file, hash, or load result.
OpenCOOD, RCP-Bench, ROBOSAC, DAIR-V2X-Seq, and Co-MTP checkpoints were not loaded; missing or restrictive licenses are recorded rather than inferred away.
